description: ⭐ THE flagship one-call tool. page_path → dresses that page; no page_path → scans the WHOLE project. Finds every placeholder/stock slot (placehold.co, picsum, unsplash, pexels…), locks/infers the style automatically, generates every image IN PARALLEL (recurring characters/products auto-used), saves optimised WebP and patches src+alt in the code. REVIEW/TESTIMONIAL sections are detected automatically: their avatars come out as ultra-real casual smartphone selfies (UGC look — car/bedroom/living-room backdrop, real skin), each reviewer keeps the SAME face across THIS site; your other sites are independent by default (set cross_site_unique:true to also keep reviewer faces distinct across ALL your sites). rebrand:true targets EXISTING real images instead: first call lists them for FREE, then apply:true regenerates them all in place (code untouched, originals kept as *.original).

apply.description: rebrand only: true applies the rebrand (default false = free list, 0 credit)

cross_site_unique.description: Default false: each of your sites draws reviewer faces independently. Pass true ONLY if the user explicitly wants reviewer faces to NEVER repeat across ALL their sites (account-wide uniqueness). Variety WITHIN a site is always enforced regardless.

dry_run.description: PREVIEW mode: lists every slot found + the planned subject of each + the exact credit estimate, and generates NOTHING (0 credit). Use it before a big run to know the cost upfront.

max_images.description: Cap per run (default 10, max 20). Leave it at the default for most pages. For a page with MANY slots, just raise it (up to 20) and call ONCE — if a few tail images get skipped to stay within the time budget, simply rerun the SAME call: already-wired images are skipped (0 extra credits), only the remaining slots generate. No need to micro-batch.

no_character.description: Default false. Pass true when THIS page has NO locked person to feature (e.g. a team page of DIFFERENT staff, a gallery of finished work): it stops any locked character (a founder's face…) from being auto-attached to the slots, so each portrait is a distinct person. Review/testimonial avatars are unaffected.

page_path.description: Page file to dress (html/jsx/tsx…). Omit to scan the whole project.

rebrand.description: true = redo EXISTING real images on-brand, in place (free proposal first)

share_avatars.description: Default true: a review repeated in two sections of the SAME page generates ONE face and reuses it (saves credits). Pass false to regenerate each one (use only if the user explicitly asks for a different face per slot).

name: make_images
title: Dress a page or the whole site with on-brand images
